    - Issue: Introducing SCHEMA_VERSION changes the cache key format, causing all existing cached profiles to become invisible. While TTL_SECONDS is 24 hours, the initial miss rate will be 100% until the cache is warmed.
    - Fix: Consider a dual-version read strategy during migration: check both the versioned and unversioned keys, or implement a rolling cache update mechanism to avoid simultaneous misses.
